user.title: Zigbang account
user.description: Used once to fetch your registered doorlocks. Runtime state/control uses the local relay instead.

relay.title: Relay
relay.description: How should the local relay run? Embedded is simplest: Home Assistant runs the relay itself (the lock goes offline while HA restarts). Choose external if you already run the relay as a Docker container or App.

menu_options.embedded: Embedded (recommended): run the relay inside Home Assistant
menu_options.external: External (advanced): connect to a relay you run yourself

embedded.title: Embedded relay
embedded.description: Home Assistant opens the lock-facing ports itself (default 18883/TCP and 5683/UDP). Enter the domain injected into the lock at provisioning and its TLS certificate. Default location is zigbang_doorlock/certs in your HA config directory; on HAOS with the Let's Encrypt App, /ssl is suggested automatically.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change these if the lock was provisioned with different ports, or if you want shadow mode.

data_description.route_mode: Shadow (default): also answers the lock locally while the Zigbang cloud is unreachable. Proxy: pass-through only.

external.title: External relay
external.description: Address of the relay's observer port (default 9883).
